# acecloud_api_key (Resource)

Manages an AceCloud IAM API key. API keys are long-lived programmatic credentials suitable for automation (CI pipelines, scripts, infrastructure tooling). 

**The API key secret is returned only when the key is created.** Save it immediately — it cannot be retrieved later from this resource's state. If lost, regenerate the secret with `ace api-key revive <id>`. 

To use an API key with this provider, configure `api_key_id`, `api_key_secret`, and `api_key_service_name` in the provider block (or via the corresponding `ACECLOUD_API_KEY_*` environment variables). The service name must match the value supplied at key creation. 

**Note**: Managing API keys (creating, updating, deleting them via this resource) requires the provider to be authenticated with a JWT token, email/password, or `ace-cli` config — not with an API key. The IAM API key management endpoints reject API-key auth.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `service_name` (String) Human-readable identifier for the service or automation that will use this key (e.g. `terraform-prod`, `ci-pipeline`). Surfaced in audit logs. Minimum 2 characters.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-form description of the key's purpose. Minimum 3 characters when set.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the key can be used for authentication. Defaults to `true`. Set to `false` to disable the key without deleting it; flip back to `true` to re-enable.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp of key creation.
- `expires_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp when the key expires (auto-set by the platform).
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the API key. Combine with `secret` to form the full credential (`<id>.<secret>`).
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) The API key secret. Returned only when the key is created and stored in Terraform state thereafter. Save it to a secret manager immediately — if state is lost, regenerate with `ace api-key revive <id>`. Always referenced as `sensitive`.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp of the last update to this key.
